chunks: Hammad narrated from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
It is recommended for a man to draw near on the evening of Arafah and the Day of Arafah through emancipation and charity.

key_terms.الصَّدَقَةِ: charitable giving for the sake of Allah
key_terms.عَشِيَّةَ عَرَفَةَ: the evening before the Day of Arafah
key_terms.يَتَقَرَّبَ: to seek nearness to Allah through devotional action
key_terms.يَوْمَ عَرَفَةَ: the Day of Arafah during hajj
key_terms.يُسْتَحَبُّ: is recommended and encouraged in religious practice

ai.seo_question: What acts are recommended on the evening and day of Arafah to draw closer to Allah?
ai.summary: This hadith states that it is recommended to seek nearness to Allah on the evening and day of Arafah through freeing slaves and giving charity. It highlights virtuous acts of worship and generosity connected to the blessed time of Arafah.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3434 - Hammad narrated from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:
"It is recommended for a man to draw closer to Allah (swt) on the evening of Arafah and the Day of Arafah through freeing slaves and giving charity."
